fields.statement: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj sets TargetFramework to net10.0, Nullable to enable, and ImplicitUsings to enable; these are the project file's only target-framework and nullable/implicit-usings settings, and no other PropertyGroup in the file names a different TargetFramework, Nullable, or ImplicitUsings value.
